### 2. Challenge Findings and Verification Evidence

- **Challenge 1 (Worktree & HEAD Hygiene):** Verified exact branch `codex/review-ordinary-diary-cancellation-repair-bfac6529`, HEAD `bfac65298e1d4aaca85d1c9dcb20329ef298c485`, and clean worktree before (C01, C02) and after (C08, C09) all command execution.
- **Challenge 2 (Delete-Only Ordinary Command Path):** In [`docs/diary/diary.js`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r198/docs/diary/diary.js#L10534-L10557), [`deleteBooking()`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r198/docs/diary/diary.js#L10473-L10617) issues only dedicated delete proposal requests to `/appointments/proposals/delete/${encodeURIComponent(appointmentId)}`. The legacy 404 string search and semantic downgrade fallback to status proposals/confirms and raw `DELETE` have been completely excised. Any non-OK, 404, or transport failure sets a terminal failed outcome and proceeds immediately to fresh reconciliation without calling status endpoints, the hyphenated alias, or raw `DELETE`. Built-in smoke mode explicitly declines cancellation simulation and points to route-intercepted review evidence ([`docs/diary/diary.js`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r198/docs/diary/diary.js#L10523-L10528)).
- **Challenge 3 (Shared Proposal Validator):** In [`docs/diary/diary.js`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r198/docs/diary/diary.js#L9638-L9686), [`validateDeleteProposalForConfirmation()`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r198/docs/diary/diary.js#L9638-L9686) binds `appointment_id`, allowlisted `status_reason_code` in `DELETE_CONFIRM_REASON_CODE_OPTIONS`, exact optional `cancellation_reason` (<=500 chars), recursive issue validation (`validDeleteConfirmIssue`), exact command matching, `intent === "delete_appointment"`, `requires_confirmation === true`, exact autonomy tier (`proposal` vs `blocked`), and canonical endpoint `/appointments/proposals/delete/confirm`.
- **Challenge 4 (Mandatory Visible Staff Confirmation):** In [`docs/diary/diary.js`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r198/docs/diary/diary.js#L10479-L10493), the deliberate first destructive click transforms the button to "Confirm Cancel" and reveals reason input fields. On the second click, [`showStatusProposalDialog(proposal)`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r198/docs/diary/diary.js#L10559) opens visible modal confirmation. If staff cancels or presses Escape (`!confirmed`), the flow records a non-confirmed outcome (`cancelled`) and issues zero confirm HTTP requests, proceeding directly to fresh reconciliation.
- **Challenge 5 (Canonical Endpoint & Minimal Public Receipt):** [`applySignedDeleteProposal()`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r198/docs/diary/diary.js#L11057-L11090) validates the proposal, POSTs only to canonical `/appointments/proposals/delete/confirm` using `deleteConfirmIdempotencyKey`, and validates the response through [`validateDeleteConfirmPublicEnvelope()`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r198/docs/diary/diary.js#L9688-L9746). The validator strictly enforces exact top-level keys `DELETE_CONFIRM_PUBLIC_ENVELOPE_KEYS`, schema `raisa.delete_confirm_public_envelope.v1`, minimal receipt `appointment.delete_confirmation_receipt.v1`, and explicitly rejects any `appointment` read-model object or private receipt fields.
- **Challenge 6 (Reconciliation via Fresh Authorized Read):** [`reconcileOrdinaryCancellation()`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r198/docs/diary/diary.js#L10458-L10471) executes `await loadDiary(true)` after every terminal or uncertain outcome (committed, replay, blocked, staff cancelled, transport uncertainty, non-OK, or malformed responses). No optimistic cache modification or appointment deletion is performed.
- **Challenge 7 (Current Read Truth Defeats Contradictory Receipt):** When `loadDiary(true)` reconciles and finds the appointment still active/un-cancelled ([`docs/diary/diary.js`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r198/docs/diary/diary.js#L10610-L10617)), any receipt success claim is defeated, displaying `"A cancellation receipt was returned, but the current Diary still shows this appointment. Success has not been assumed; review current truth before trying again."`
- **Challenge 8 (Narrow Test Timing Repair Verification):** The test harness repairs in [`review/test_reception_one_cancellation_action.py`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r198/review/test_reception_one_cancellation_action.py#L633-L638) and [`review/test_diary_smoke.py`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r198/review/test_diary_smoke.py#L1218) preserve the exact same activeElement focus predicate (`page.wait_for_function(...)` with `WAIT_TIMEOUT`) and allow 30 seconds for the one full-page cleanup reload. In C04, all 170 tests across the three combined suites passed deterministically in a single process without test weakening.
- **Challenge 9 (Route-Intercepted Authored Synthetic Evidence):** Reception One cancellation tests, ordinary Diary cancellation convergence tests, and full Diary smoke tests are green and explicitly labelled route-intercepted authored synthetic evidence in docstrings and assertions.
- **Challenge 10 (Register Provenance AER-0391–AER-0395):** Verified [`docs/ariadne-agent-error-correction-register-revision-344.md`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r198/docs/ariadne-agent-error-correction-register-revision-344.md), [`docs/ariadne-agent-error-correction-register-revision-345.md`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r198/docs/ariadne-agent-error-correction-register-revision-345.md), and durable store [`orchestration/continuity/ariadne-agent-error-register/agent-error-register.json`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/r198/orchestration/continuity/ariadne-agent-error-register/agent-error-register.json). Incidents AER-0391 (DeepSeek exit-1 transport), AER-0392 (preflight branch-prefix argument), AER-0393 (combined browser focus race and reload timeout), AER-0394 (post-compaction receipt adapter fields), and AER-0395 (register revision 345 count alignment) accurately preserve transport/preflight/harness provenance without false product attribution. Revision 345 retains 395 incidents, 0 open, and C05 passed with exit code 0.
- **Challenge 11 (Source Boundary and Scope):** Product source is unchanged after `cb658943...`. No backend, API Spine, OpenAPI (`docs/api-spine/openapi/appointment-commands.yaml`), schema (`app/schemas/appointments.py`), router (`app/routers/appointments.py`), service (`app/services/diary/confirm_actions.py`), migration, or database file changed. No provider, data, deployment, Pages, release, or protected-ref authority was opened.
- **Challenge 12 (Exact Manifest Command Execution):** All 9 commands (C01–C09) executed in exact order and all completed with exit code 0. HEAD and worktree remain clean.

---

### 3. Conclusion

The repaired candidate cleanly aligns ordinary Diary cancellation with the accepted Reception One/kernel contract (dedicated delete proposal, shared strict proposal admission, visible staff confirmation, canonical delete-confirm, minimal public receipt, and fresh-truth reconciliation), and the narrow browser test timing repair stabilizes the verifier without assertion dilution. All manifest checks pass with zero defects.
